alignments.note: Future παραστήσει; the auxiliary rides with the verb and the head is the lexical word (rules 9, 17), discontinuously across the negative.
The ASV writes to God with no determiner, so the article has no the to anchor and the case preposition stays with the noun (rules 21, 23).
Dative θεῷ with its case preposition, headed on the noun.
The first οὔτε → neither; the correlative pair is aligned in the English order neither … nor, which is fixed, even though the ASV's clauses stand in the reverse order from the projection.
The ASV writes no word for γάρ here; decided on the English alone.
The ἐάν of the μή-clause: the ASV places that clause first, and rule 15 permits the reordering.
The φάγωμεν of the μή-clause with its supplied subject; head on the lexical verb.
μή → not; the ASV postposes it after the verb.
ὑστερούμεθα rendered by the predicate frame are we the worse; head on the meaning-bearing complement rather than the copula (rule 17). The packet's gloss note records the Greek do we lack.
The ἐάν of the affirmative clause, which the ASV places second.
φάγωμεν with its supplied subject; head on the lexical verb.
περισσεύομεν rendered by the predicate frame are we the better; head on the meaning-bearing complement (rule 17). The packet's gloss note records the Greek do we abound.

review_notes: v009 is marked FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE: the projection carries r00-base over s009–s017 while the evidence leaves r02 and r03, and the ASV plainly follows a reading in which the two conditional clauses stand in the reverse order (eat not / worse, then eat / better). Every token of the projection still has an English counterpart, so nothing here is added or unrepresented on that account and the difference is handled as reordering under rule 15; γάρ is unrepresented because the ASV writes no word for it, not on textual grounds. Rule 12 is untouched — no new textual decision is taken.

The two οὔτε tokens are aligned positionally to neither and nor, the English correlative order being fixed; aligning them to the clauses they introduce in the projection would cross the pair and is not taken.
